explanation.headline: FDA's shortage list shows Strides Pharma Inc. discontinued ursodiol capsules on 2026-04-06; the drug is not on the list as of 2026-10-21

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include ursodiol as of 2026-10-21.
The list previously recorded Strides Pharma Inc. discontinuing manufacture of ursodiol capsules with an initial posting date of 2026-04-06.
Corvale General holds 303 capsules of the 300 mg presentation, providing 31.6 days of supply at the current usage rate.
The top-ranked purchasing option is to buy from Actavis Pharma, Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today.
Additional alternate manufacturers include Amneal Pharmaceuticals NY LLC and Aurobindo Pharma Limited, neither of which appears on the current shortage list.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
